title: 486. Arithmetic Slices

examples.explanation: Slices [1,2,3], [2,3,4] and [1,2,3,4] share a constant step.
Fewer than three elements can never form a slice.
Every contiguous run of length at least 3 with zero step counts.

hints: A slice needs at least three entries with equal gaps between neighbours.
Extending a run ending at i adds as many new slices as the current streak length.
Keep a running streak: reset on a gap change, otherwise grow and accumulate.
